questions.prompt: Parallel rails cross a transversal. A 41° angle has a corresponding angle on the other rail. Find its measure.
On parallel lines, same-side interior angles are 41° and x°. Find x.
An alternate interior angle matches a 41° angle. Which argument explains why?

options: All four angles at a crossing are equal
Every pair of interior angles sums to 90°
Corresponding angles match, then vertical angles match
